hints.title: Boundary Delta Array Accumulation
hints.text: Record +1 delta at event start time and -1 delta at event end time to track concurrent active intervals.

hints.title: Prefix Sum Sweep Across Ordered Time Keys
hints.text: Update the endpoint counts. Sweep sequentially through all recorded timestamps, accumulating a running prefix sum of active bookings and tracking the maximum value.

hints.title: MyCalendarThree Book Blueprint
hints.text: In book(startTime, endTime): increment delta[startTime] by 1 and decrement delta[endTime] by 1. Loop through sorted delta keys, accumulate running sum, compute max, and return it.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Sorting unique boundary keys takes O(N log N) time; running sweep runs in O(N).

complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Difference map stores 2N boundary points instead of continuous ranges.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Understanding sweep-line delta accumulation for maximum concurrent overlap.
